cafe-01.name: Cauliflower pie
steps: In a large bowl, mix the yoghurt, eggs, grated cheese, crushed garlic, seasonings, herbs and salt. Cut the cauliflower and broccoli into florets, wash well and cut into small pieces. Mix with the prepared sauce and transfer to a baking dish. Bake for 40–50 minutes at 180°C until golden.

cafe-02.name: Bread (low carb, gluten-free)
steps: Whisk all the ingredients together thoroughly in a bowl. Let the dough rest for 15 minutes. The thick, slippery dough can be transferred with a spatula to a baking tray lined with baking paper and shaped into a loaf. Bake for 40–45 minutes at 170°C until golden.

cafe-03.name: Cheese biscuits
steps: Coarsely grate the courgette and squeeze out as much water as possible using gauze or a cloth. In a bowl, mix the squeezed courgette with crumbled feta, egg, oats, peas, sesame seeds, salt and black pepper. Use a spoon to make a thicker mixture, then place small portions on a baking tray lined with baking paper, shaping them into small fritters. Bake for 25–30 minutes at 200°C.

cafe-04.name: Cornmeal porridge
steps: Mix the polenta, cinnamon, honey and milk in a saucepan. Stir continuously as the porridge comes to the boil, then keep stirring until it reaches the desired consistency. Add more milk if needed. Pour into a bowl, add chopped peach and serve. You can also sprinkle it with raisins and walnuts.

cafe-05.name: Quick breakfast cereal
steps: Blend the quark, bananas, dates and cinnamon in a food processor until creamy. Add the desiccated coconut and chia seeds (or poppy seeds), then top the cereal with fruit and walnuts.

cafe-06.name: Protein mocha
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond milk (or coconut, oat or cow's milk)
steps: First, prepare the coffee to taste and let it cool. Put all the ingredients, including the coffee, into a blender (the source recommends a particular blender) and blend well. Serve the protein shake immediately.

cafe-07.name: Simple oat doughnuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk of your choice (125 ml)
steps: Mix the dry ingredients first, then add the remaining ingredients. Divide the batter between the cavities of a silicone doughnut mould. If using a non-silicone mould, grease it with a little coconut oil beforehand. Bake for 15–18 minutes at 180°C. For a sugar-like finish, dust the baked doughnuts with coconut flour or use another topping you like. They can also be served with good-quality homemade jam.

cafe-08.name: Cranberry and almond cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil or coconut butter
steps: Blend the almonds and oats into a flour and pour into a bowl. Stir in the other dry ingredients. Add the egg, egg white, apple purée, honey and coconut oil or butter, and mix well. Pour into a small silicone baking tin or a tin lined with baking paper (approximately 20 × 20 cm). Bake at 175°C for 18–20 minutes.

cafe-09.name: Banana and oat cookies
ingredients: Desiccated coconut, nuts or raisins, if desired
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Mash the bananas and add the other ingredients. Mix, then shape the dough into small cookies on the tray. Bake for 15 minutes at 190°C.

cafe-10.name: Protein mug cake (gluten-free, sugar-free)
ingredients: 21 scoops protein powder of your choice (ambiguous quantity in the source)
steps: Put all the ingredients in a large mug or small bowl and stir. Microwave for 1 minute, then for another 30 seconds on high power.
notes: Ambiguous quantity in the source: the PDF states "21 scoops of protein". Confirm the correct quantity before preparing.

cafe-11.name: Banana and cinnamon soufflé
steps: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks. Gently fold in the mashed banana and cinnamon. Divide between two ramekins or other small baking dishes and bake for about 10 minutes at 200°C.

cafe-12.name: Toast with avocado, scrambled eggs and radish
steps: Toast the wholemeal bread in a frying pan or toaster. Peel the avocado, remove the stone and mash in a bowl with a fork. Season with black pepper. Heat a non-stick pan, then add the beaten eggs seasoned with salt and garlic powder. Stir until the eggs are well cooked. Wash, trim and chop the radishes. Top the warm toast with mashed avocado, then scrambled eggs and radish.

cafe-13.name: Walnut cake (gluten-free)
steps: Grind the walnuts into a flour in a food processor, then add the egg yolks and honey. In another bowl, whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks. Carefully fold them into the walnut mixture. Pour into a silicone tin or a baking tin lined with baking paper; a loaf tin can also be used. Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes. Serve with jam, nut butter or on its own.

cafe-14.name: Banana fitness muffins (gluten-free, sugar-free)
steps: The protein powder can be replaced with pudding mix, milk powder or almond flour, sweetened to taste. Blend all the ingredients. Half-fill muffin cases and bake at 190°C for 15–20 minutes until golden. The final texture depends on the protein powder chosen: the muffins may be firmer or softer. The source recommends vanilla whey protein concentrate for the best results.

cafe-15.name: Banana pancakes
steps: Blend the banana and eggs until smooth. Spoon the batter into a frying pan and cook until small bubbles begin to form. Turn the pancakes and continue cooking until golden on both sides. Serve with your preferred accompaniment.

cafe-16.name: Tuna sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chickpea flour or wholemeal flour
Ground black pepper and ground red paprika
steps: Drain the tuna and mix with the egg and 3 tablespoons of flour. Add the seasonings and salt to taste. Pour into a small baking tin lined with baking paper. Bake at 180°C for 10–15 minutes. Divide the baked mixture into two equal pieces and fill with ingredients of your choice. Cut diagonally and serve the sandwich warm or chilled.

cafe-17.name: Chickpea pancakes
steps: In a bowl, mix the chickpea flour, water, flaxseed, grated cheese, basil and salt. You can add other ingredients, such as chopped olives or sun-dried tomatoes. Pour approximately 1/2 cup of batter per pancake onto a non-stick cooking surface and cook on both sides until golden. The recipe generally makes 4 pancakes, but you can make them larger or smaller. Fill with ingredients of your choice and serve warm.

cafe-18.name: Healthy tuna spread
ingredients: 120 g tuna in water (or olive oil)
steps: Put the tuna with its water or olive oil into a blender. Add the remaining ingredients and blend until smooth. Spread on wholemeal bread or another bread of your choice. Finish with chopped chives or spring onion if desired.

cafe-19.name: Strawberry and oat cream
steps: Blend the strawberries until smooth. Pour into a bowl and mix well with the remaining ingredients. Divide between bowls or bottles, cover with lids and refrigerate for 5 hours.

cafe-20.name: Sweet chickpea porridge
ingredients: Fruit, dark chocolate (70%+), cocoa nibs, raisins, nuts or desiccated coconut
steps: Blend the chickpeas, apple purée, milk, oats, sweetener and a pinch of salt until completely smooth. Add protein powder if desired; if it is flavoured, use less sweetener to taste. When no chickpea pieces remain, add fruit, dark chocolate, cocoa nibs or raisins and serve.

iridium-01.name: Courgette frittata
ingredients: 1/2 cup oat flour or fine wholemeal wheat flour
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Grate the courgettes and squeeze out the excess water, drying them well with kitchen paper if needed. Mix with the other ingredients in a bowl and set aside.
Preheat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat; grease with a drop of olive oil if needed. Pour in the mixture to form a disc and brown for 3 minutes on each side.

iridium-02.name: Risotto
ingredients: 1 dessertspoon light cream cheese or light requeijão
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Sauté the chicken, onion and chopped vegetables in olive oil. Once everything is cooked, add the cooked brown rice and finish with cream cheese. Serve topped with parsley and nuts.
The source describes this as a complete dish combining a good amount of protein, a moderate amount of carbohydrates, vegetables and nuts.

iridium-03.name: Quinoa burger
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Wash the quinoa and cook it in water. In another pan, add the olive oil, herbs, cooked quinoa and flour, and mix well. Shape into burgers, then cook in a frying pan until golden.

iridium-04.name: Protein banana ice cream
steps: Slice and freeze the bananas. Blend the frozen banana in a food processor until creamy. Add the whey, blend a little more and serve.

iridium-05.name: Cookies
steps: Grind the nuts to crumbs in a blender or food processor, then mix with all the ingredients except the chocolate.
Shape the cookies, arrange on a baking tray and top with chocolate chips. Bake in a moderate oven for about 15 minutes.

iridium-06.name: Banana and strawberry ice cream
steps: Slice the bananas, chop the strawberries and freeze the fruit for 2 hours. Remove from the freezer and let it thaw for 5 minutes.
Blend in a blender or food processor until creamy. Serve immediately.
Yield: 2 servings

iridium-07.name: Strawberry chia pudding
steps: Mix the chia into the coconut milk with stevia to taste and refrigerate overnight until the chia is hydrated. Top with chopped strawberries before serving.

iridium-08.name: Beijinho coconut sweets
steps: Beat all the ingredients together in a bowl for about 5 minutes. Shape into balls, add desiccated coconut, place in a dish and bake until lightly golden on top.
Yield: up to 2 servings

iridium-09.name: Spoonable brigadeiro
ingredients: 1 cup chopped 70% cocoa chocolate or chocolate chips
steps: In a medium saucepan, stir the banana biomass, sweetener and ghee continuously over medium heat until they reach the consistency of condensed milk. The source's method names ghee, while its ingredient list names coconut oil.
Add the chocolate and keep stirring until completely melted. Add the coconut milk and pinch of salt, then stir until the mixture begins to pull away from the pan.
Leave to cool, then serve.
Yield: 4 servings

iridium-10.name: Truffles
steps: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly until uniform. Shape into balls and roll in cocoa powder.
Yield: 2 servings

iridium-11.name: Chocolate crepioca
steps: Mix all the ingredients well and spread in a non-stick frying pan. Cook over low to medium heat until golden, then turn.
Remove from the heat and roll into a cigar shape. If desired, make a whey protein topping to increase the protein content, as suggested by the source.

iridium-12.name: High-calorie shake
steps: Blend all the ingredients in a blender.

iridium-13.name: Chicken and avocado sandwich
ingredients: Lettuce or rocket leaves as desired
steps: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper, then place in a pan or grill. Turn as it cooks until well browned. Squeeze the juice of half the lemon into the pan and cover. Cook until the chicken is cooked through and golden on both sides. Remove from the heat and leave to rest.

Halve the avocado, remove the flesh and place in a bowl. Season with a pinch of salt, black pepper, parsley, garlic and the juice of the other lemon half. Mix with a fork, lightly mashing the avocado, then add the mayonnaise.
Toast the bread if desired. Spread most of the avocado mayonnaise on one slice and the rest on the other. Add small pieces of chicken and lettuce, then cover with the second slice.

iridium-14.name: Bacon and egg cheeseburger
steps: Season the beef with salt, mix and shape into a burger. Cook in a frying pan for a few minutes. Turn it and add the cheese when nearly done. Once the burger is fully cooked and the mozzarella melted, remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, fry the egg and bacon in a non-stick pan. Put the burger on the bottom bun spread with mayonnaise, then add the egg, bacon, lettuce and tomato. Close the bun and serve.

iridium-15.name: Protein oat porridge
steps: Blend all the ingredients and pour into a saucepan over high heat. Heat while stirring with a spoon until the mixture thickens. Remove from the heat and serve.

iridium-16.name: Protein bars
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until uniform.
Place in a baking tin lined with baking paper. Press down and smooth the surface with a spatula. Freeze for approximately 30 minutes, then cut into bars and store in the refrigerator.

iridium-17.name: High-protein savoury parcel
ingredients: 50 g cooked cauliflower in small florets*
1 teaspoon grated Parmesan; *the cauliflower may be replaced with carrot, broccoli, sweet potato, cassava or pumpkin
steps: Preheat the oven to 250°C. Blend all the ingredients in a food processor or blender until paste-like. Divide into two pieces and shape as desired.
Place a filling of hearts of palm and olives, ricotta or ingredients of your choice on the first piece. Cover with the second piece of dough and seal the edges carefully.
Brush the parcel with egg yolk. Grease a baking tin to prevent sticking, place the parcel in it, sprinkle with Parmesan and put it in the oven.
Bake for about 20 minutes until golden with a crisp crust. Check that the inside is not raw before removing from the oven.

iridium-18.name: High-protein chickpea burgers
ingredients: Wholemeal wheat flour, fine rolled oats or rice flour to bind (approximately 1/2 cup)
steps: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the garlic and onion until lightly golden.
Add the chickpeas, season, mix well and sauté for about 3 minutes. Leave to cool.
Once cooler, gradually add the wholemeal flour, fine rolled oats or rice flour until the mixture can be shaped.
Shape into burgers, place on baking paper and freeze for one hour so they are firmer for grilling.
Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a non-stick frying pan and cook the burgers over medium heat until lightly golden on both sides.
Wait until well browned before turning so they do not fall apart.

iridium-19.name: High-calorie kibbeh
ingredients: 1 cup chopped parsley and spring onion
steps: Soak the bulgur in 3 cups of boiling water for about one hour or until soft.
Hydrate the textured soya protein as well. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats with 1/2 cup water and leave to rest.
Put the lentils in a saucepan with water and a pinch of salt. Boil until tender.
Meanwhile, finely chop the garlic and onion. Drain and rinse the soya protein, and drain the lentils. Sauté the garlic in the olive oil until golden, then add the onion and lentils and sauté.
Add the soya protein and season with salt, mint, oregano, parsley and spring onion. Mix well, then add the soaked oats and bulgur. Adjust the salt to taste.
Put the mixture in a baking tin and bake in a preheated moderate oven for 30 minutes or until golden.

iridium-20.name: High-calorie baked burger buns
ingredients: Seasonings to taste: salt, curry powder, parsley and spring onion
steps: Dough: mix the warm water, olive oil, salt, sugar and flaxseed in a bowl. Separately mix the yeast with the flours, then combine with the liquid until the dough is elastic and comes away from your hands. Stickier dough allows the buns to rise more, but it must be firm enough to wrap around the filling.
Cover the dough with a cloth and leave to rest.

Burgers: heat the water until nearly boiling and hydrate the textured soya protein for approximately 15 minutes, until it absorbs the water. Drain and squeeze out as much excess water as possible. Add olive oil, salt, curry powder and finely chopped parsley and spring onion. Add the flour gradually until the mixture can be shaped, adjusting the quantity if necessary. Divide into equal balls, shape into burgers and place on a tray. Top with slices of deseeded tomato.

Assembly: divide the rested dough into balls and flatten each in your palm. Place a burger and tomato on it, pull the dough edges around the filling and place on a greased tray. Leave the filled buns to rise again in a warm place. In cold weather, warm the oven first and let them rest inside without baking. Bake in a preheated moderate oven for about 30 minutes until golden.
The burger can also be prepared and eaten separately. Vegetarians can use an ordinary bread roll to assemble their burger.

iridium-21.name: Low-carb guacamole
ingredients: Dried seasonings: granulated garlic, dried onion, chilli flakes and oregano
steps: Mash the avocado with a fork and season with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.

iridium-22.name: Low-carb vegan leaf and nut salad
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Mix the salt, pepper and vinegar in a small bowl. Gradually add the olive oil while whisking with a fork until combined. Set aside.
Arrange the leaves in a salad bowl, sprinkle with the nuts and drizzle with the dressing.

iridium-23.name: Pancake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cashew, quinoa or chia flour
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth. Pour into a frying pan over low heat and cook until firm. Turn, cook the other side and add a filling of your choice.

iridium-24.name: Keto bread
steps: Beat the egg with a fork until uniform, then mix in the coconut flour. Microwave for approximately 1 1/2 minutes, until a firm crust forms but the inside is still uncooked.
Remove from the microwave and put the dough in a frying pan until crisp and fully cooked.

iridium-25.name: Salmon tartare with guacamole
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste; Guacamole ingredients:
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Salmon tartare: finely dice the salmon and chop the chilli into very small pieces. Mix with the other tartare ingredients and set aside.
Guacamole: dice the avocado, red onion and tomato. Add finely chopped chilli and coriander, then gently mix all the ingredients without completely mashing the avocado.
Assembly: put the tartare in a serving glass or bowl and spoon a little guacamole on top.
Serve cold.

iridium-26.name: Cauliflower rice
steps: Steam the cauliflower thoroughly. Separate the florets and chop finely.
Heat the butter in a pan and sauté the finely chopped cauliflower. Adjust the salt and pepper and serve.

iridium-27.name: Bauru sandwich
steps: To make the bread, mix the egg thoroughly with the two tablespoons of requeijão, then stir in the baking powder.

Grease a square container with olive oil, add the mixture and microwave for about 2 1/2 minutes. Remove, turn out, cut in half and fill with mozzarella, turkey, tomato and oregano, or a filling of your choice. Finish in a sandwich toaster.

iridium-28.name: Frying-pan pizza base
steps: Mix and blend all the ingredients. Spread in a pizza tin and bake in a hot oven for about 10 minutes. Turn the base and bake the other side. Add toppings of your choice.

iridium-29.name: Frying-pan apple pie
ingredients: Ghee or coconut oil for greasing
steps: Peel the apple, slice thinly and set aside. Beat the egg, flour, cream and baking powder with a hand blender or fork.
Grease and preheat a non-stick frying pan, wiping away excess butter with kitchen paper. Add the sweetener and cinnamon, arrange the apple slices, then pour the batter over everything.
Cover and cook over low heat for approximately 7 minutes or until cooked. Turn out and sprinkle with cinnamon.

iridium-30.name: Tuna pie
ingredients: 1 cup wholemeal wheat flour (or flour of your choice)
1 1/2 cups soya milk (or milk of your choice)
1/3 cup (approximately 100 ml) coconut or sunflower oil
steps: Blend all the batter ingredients. Pour half into a greased or silicone baking tin. Combine the filling ingredients, mix well and spread over the batter.
Pour the remaining batter over the filling and bake in an oven preheated to 230°C for approximately 25 minutes.

iridium-31.name: Protein brigadeiro
steps: Mix all the ingredients until uniform, then roll into balls.
Grate a little dark chocolate and sprinkle it over the balls like chocolate sprinkles, or roll them in cinnamon.

iridium-32.name: Tuna burgers
steps: Process the onion, garlic, carrot, parsley and spring onion into a paste.
Put the mixture in a bowl, add all the remaining ingredients and shape into burgers.

iridium-33.name: Protein banana smoothie
ingredients: 30 g whey protein concentrate, flavour of your choice
steps: Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend. Add a little more milk if the smoothie is too thick.

iridium-34.name: Beef burgers
ingredients: 500 g minced beef, preferably lean patinho cut
Salt, pepper and other seasonings to taste
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until uniform, then place the burger mixture in a non-stick frying pan to cook.

iridium-35.name: Chicken and oat burgers
steps: Mix all the ingredients until uniform. Shape into patties with your hands, then place in a non-stick frying pan to cook.

iridium-36.name: Sweet potato and chicken bake
steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil, then add the garlic and chicken and sauté a little longer. Add the tomato sauce, cook for 5 minutes, then add the cottage cheese and seasonings.
Separately, cook the sweet potatoes in enough water to cover them. Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil, then add the cooked, mashed sweet potatoes. Stir and season with salt.
Spread some of the mash in an ovenproof dish and add the filling. Cover with the remaining mash and bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for about 10–15 minutes, until golden.

iridium-37.name: Turkey and cottage cheese pancakes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil or oil of your choice; Filling ingredients:
steps: Blend all the batter ingredients and cook enough batter to cover the bottom of a frying pan.
Fill each pancake with a slice of smoked turkey breast and 1 tablespoon cottage cheese.

iridium-38.name: Eggs with lentils
ingredients: Salt and pepper to taste; For the eggs:
steps: Sauté the lentils in olive oil in a frying pan, stirring for approximately 5 minutes. Add salt and cayenne pepper and stir for another 5–7 minutes. When the lentils appear brown around the edges, add the parsley and remove from the pan.

Cut the red pepper into 4 rings and remove the seeds as needed. Heat a little oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook the pepper rings for 3–4 minutes on each side until softened. Break an egg into each ring, season with salt and pepper and cook until the top is set.
Serve the lentils on a plate with the egg on top.

iridium-39.name: Peanut butter protein bars
steps: Heat the honey in a saucepan. Add the sugar and stir well until the mixture starts bubbling.
Add the cinnamon and stir again. Add the peanut butter and stir until everything is very smooth.
Turn off the heat and add the oats and flaxseed. Mix and spread on a clean, cool tray. Freeze overnight.
The next day, cut into squares to take as an afternoon or evening snack.

iridium-40.name: Peanut butter pancakes
ingredients: 2 dessertspoons peanut butter, melted in the microwave
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until uniform. Heat a frying pan and put a tablespoon of the mixture in the centre.
Cook until bubbles begin to appear on the surface, then use a spatula to turn the pancake and cook the other side.
Cook a little longer and serve with a jam of your choice.

iridium-41.name: Peanut butter smoothie
ingredients: 1 scoop chocolate or vanilla whey protein
steps: Blend all the ingredients until they have a smoothie consistency, then serve. The source describes it as a practical, quick and tasty drink for a training routine.

iridium-42.name: Peanut butter brigadeiro
steps: Put the peanut butter in a glass with the water and microwave for one minute.
Leave to cool slightly, then add the carob, cocoa and whey. Mix well until it reaches a brigadeiro-like consistency.
Shape into small balls and decorate with crushed nuts. The source presents this as a delicately finished treat for a training routine.

iridium-43.name: Traditional peanut butter and jam sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sugar-free jam made from your favourite fruit
steps: Spread peanut butter on one slice of bread and jam on the other. Put the slices together and enjoy.

iridium-44.name: Peanut butter granola
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Meanwhile, spread the oats on a clean baking tray and set aside.
Put the peanut butter and honey in a bowl and microwave on high for about 20 seconds until well melted.
Stir in the cinnamon and vanilla extract. Add the oats and mix until all the grains are coated with the peanut butter and honey mixture.
Spread the mixture back over the baking tray and bake for about 7–8 minutes.
Watch for the granola to become crisp and darker in colour. Once ready, serve as a snack with fruit, yoghurt or any dish to which you normally add granola.

iridium-45.name: Lebanese kidney bean and lemon salad
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.

The source states that kidney beans contain a good amount of protein: approximately 15 g per cup of cooked beans. Together with chickpeas, it describes the salad as supplying essential amino acids and helping increase protein intake.

The source also describes the beans as providing dietary fibre, vitamins and minerals such as iron, copper, potassium and vitamin K, as well as active compounds with antioxidant action, such as isoflavones.
The source reports a study of 30 obese men and women on a weight-loss diet: the group eating beans 4 times a week for 2 months lost more weight than the group that did not eat beans.

iridium-46.name: Thai salad
ingredients: 1 jalapeño, peeled, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
The source describes this unusual salad as healthy and containing a good amount of beneficial fats from peanuts and sesame oil.
For people seeking to increase calorie and carbohydrate intake, the source presents it as an option because of its fats and the carbohydrates supplied by mango.

iridium-47.name: Chickpea, carrot and dill salad
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
The source presents this salad as an option for increasing protein intake or reducing hunger by increasing the feeling of fullness.
It describes pumpkin seeds as rich in mono- and polyunsaturated fats, fibre, B vitamins and minerals such as zinc and magnesium, which it highlights for people who train.
The source also describes celery, spring onion and dill as providing vitamins, minerals and antioxidants.

iridium-48.name: Sun-dried tomato, spinach and quinoa salad
ingredients: 2 cups roughly chopped spinach or rocket
Salt to taste; Lemon dressing ingredients:
A pinch of red chilli flakes
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
The source describes this as a light, low-calorie salad with good nutritional quality.
It describes quinoa as a source of protein, beneficial fats including omega-3, and dietary fibre, and claims it is the grain with the highest iron content.
The source describes spinach as rich in vitamins and minerals such as calcium, which it notes is needed for muscle contraction during physical activity.

iridium-49.name: Colourful beetroot, carrot, quinoa and spinach salad
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
The source describes this salad, with quinoa, spinach, carrot, beetroot and pumpkin seeds, as providing protein, carbohydrates and beneficial fats.

It highlights beetroot's nitrate content, stating that nitrate increases nitric oxide and therefore vasodilation and blood flow to muscles. It cites a study published in a journal of the American College of Sports Medicine as reporting that beetroot juice may also increase muscle contraction power independently of blood flow.

The source calls edamame, or green soya beans, the main ingredient. It describes it as increasingly popular in Brazil and as providing approximately 17 g protein per 100 g, together with fats such as omega-3, fibre, vitamins and minerals.

iridium-50.name: Greek broccoli salad
ingredients: 1 cooked broccoli, cut into small pieces
1/4 cup thinly sliced feta or another goat's cheese
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
The source presents this light salad as a more flavourful alternative to plain cooked broccoli, noting its popularity among people who exercise because of its nutritional value.
It describes broccoli as rich in various vitamins and minerals, with a good amount of protein relative to its carbohydrate content.

iridium-51.name: Sweet potato salad
ingredients: 1 kg cooked sweet potato, cut into medium slices
steps: Wash all the leaves and vegetables thoroughly, cut as desired and combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
The source presents this salad as an alternative to plain boiled or roasted sweet potato and as a pre-workout option.
It describes sweet potato as a low-glycaemic-index carbohydrate source that helps maintain energy for longer during training.
The source also attributes thermogenic and antioxidant action to the pepper, describes olive oil as rich in beneficial fats, and highlights parsley, celery and spring onion as nutritious.

iridium-52.name: Protein bars 1
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl until uniform.
Put the mixture in a baking tin lined with baking paper. Press down and smooth the surface with a spatula.
Freeze for approximately 30 minutes, then remove, cut into bars and keep refrigerated.

iridium-53.name: Protein bars 2
steps: Mash the banana and sweet potato and mix with the other ingredients. Once uniform, place in a baking tin and bake for approximately 10 minutes. Watch carefully so the mixture does not become hard.
Remove and cut into bars. Store in the refrigerator.

iridium-54.name: Peanut butter
steps: Spread the peanuts on a baking tray and roast at 200°C for approximately 15 minutes, until toasted.
Leave to cool and put in a food processor. They will first turn into crumbs; continue processing as they release oil and become a dough, then peanut butter.
This can take a little time. Keep processing until it reaches the familiar peanut butter consistency. Use stevia if you want a sweet version.

iridium-55.name: Cereal bars 1
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hydrated chia (1 spoon chia to 1 spoon water)
steps: Soak the chia in water at a 1:1 ratio for 10 minutes. Drain and mix all the ingredients until they form a shapeable dough.
Put in a baking tray or tin lined with baking paper and press evenly with a spoon.
Refrigerate for about 2 hours. Remove and cut.

iridium-56.name: Cereal bars 2
steps: Mix all the ingredients and spread in a baking tin with a spoon. Unlike the other bar recipes, cut these bars before putting them in the oven.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for approximately 15 minutes. Leave to cool before removing from the tin.

iridium-57.name: Mayonnaise
steps: Boil the eggs until the yolks are firm. Peel and put in a blender with the salt and lemon juice. Blend on low speed while gradually adding olive oil and watching the consistency. It is ready when smooth and mayonnaise-like.

iridium-58.name: Homemade chicken nuggets
steps: Chop the garlic and onion and mix with the chicken. Add the salt, chives and pepper and mix until uniform.
Shape into nuggets, dip first in egg and then in cornmeal to coat. Preheat the oven to 200°C for 10 minutes, then bake for approximately 30 minutes.

iridium-59.name: Crispy chicken with mustard sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 fine rolled oats (unit not specified in the source)
Olive oil to taste; Sauce ingredients:
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Mix the oats, onion, salt and chilli in an ovenproof dish. In another bowl, whisk the egg whites with the water to form a foam; the source's ingredient list specifies eggs while its method specifies egg whites.
Cut the chicken into small pieces, dip into the egg whites and then into the oat mixture. Press down to help the oats stick. Place on a baking tray and drizzle or spray with a little olive oil.
Bake at 180°C for approximately 10 minutes. Turn the chicken, add a little more of the oat coating and bake for about another 10 minutes, until golden.
While the chicken is in the oven, mix the yoghurt, mustard and stevia to make the sauce.

iridium-60.name: Chicken wraps
ingredients: 2 cooked chicken breasts, chopped or shredded
2 tablespoons cranberries or oil-free sun-dried tomatoes
steps: Mix the vinegar, sucralose and mayonnaise; the source lists sugar in the ingredients but sucralose in the method. Add the chicken and celery and stir well. Mix in the cranberries and walnuts. Place spinach on the wraps, add the chicken mixture and fold into wraps.

iridium-61.name: Poá chicken
ingredients: 120 g chicken breast, cut into pieces
steps: Coat the chicken with pesto. Heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the red pepper, onion and garlic until soft. Add the chicken and cook until golden, making sure the inside is not raw. Once the chicken is fully cooked, add the tomatoes and white wine and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
Finally, sprinkle with Parmesan and mozzarella and cook until the cheeses melt.

iridium-62.name: Thai chicken
ingredients: 120 g chicken breast, cut into medium pieces
2 cups cooked wholemeal angel hair pasta
steps: Prepare the pasta according to the package instructions. Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat, add the chicken and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, mix the yellow pepper, chicken stock, peanut butter, sucralose and chilli flakes; the source lists sugar in the ingredients but sucralose in the method. Add to the pan and cook for another 5 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through. Sprinkle with coriander and serve.

iridium-63.name: Chicken skewers
ingredients: 200 g chicken breast, cut into pieces
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces and thread onto skewers.
Mix all the spices and coat the chicken thoroughly. Grill or bake the skewers for about 10 minutes on each side, or until the chicken is fully cooked and golden.
Mix the yoghurt with lemon juice to make the sauce.

iridium-64.name: Chicken roulades
steps: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper. Lightly flatten with a meat mallet or rolling pin so the fillets are thinner and wider. Refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve the cheese and turkey slices. Put a piece of each in the centre of each chicken fillet and sprinkle with basil.
Roll each fillet into a cigar shape and close the edges. Secure with kitchen string or toothpicks while cooking.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over low heat. Add a few drops of olive oil and brown the rolls on all sides until cooked through. Partly cover the pan to cook the chicken inside and melt the cheese.

iridium-65.name: Baked chicken fillet with creamy sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons requeijão cream cheese or cream
steps: Season the chicken and leave it in the refrigerator while preheating the oven to 250°C. Cut a piece of foil approximately three times the size of the chicken.
Put the foil on a baking tray, shiny side up. Add a little olive oil to prevent sticking and spread the tomato sauce in the centre.
Put the chicken on the sauce and spoon the requeijão over it. Sprinkle with grated cheese, then seal the foil by folding the edges.
Bake for about 20 minutes. Carefully open the parcel and check that the chicken is fully cooked before serving.

iridium-66.name: Chicken and sweet potato bites
ingredients: 50 g cooked sweet potato or carrot
steps: Blend the cooked chicken and sweet potato in a blender or food processor with 2 tablespoons water. Once paste-like, put in a dish and briefly freeze to make shaping easier. Meanwhile, beat the egg yolks and preheat the oven to 250°C.
Shape into small bites, brush the tops with beaten egg yolk and bake for about 20 minutes.

iridium-67.name: Protein egg cups
ingredients: Parsley and spring onion to taste
steps: Arrange the turkey slices and eggs in a cupcake tin. Add a pinch of salt, parsley and spring onion. Bake until the eggs are cooked.

iridium-68.name: Protein egg and oat pancakes
steps: Spread the olive oil in a frying pan and heat it. Meanwhile, blend all the other ingredients. Pour one glass of the mixture at a time into the pan and cook for 1–2 minutes, turning so both sides become golden.

iridium-69.name: Protein omelette
ingredients: Olive oil for greasing the pan
steps: Whisk one egg white to stiff peaks and set aside. Beat the remaining ingredients in a bowl, fold in the whisked egg white and cook in a frying pan greased with olive oil.

iridium-70.name: Protein cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the lemon juice, salt and sweetener. Once uniform, carefully fold in the oat flour. Pour into a greased tin, sprinkle with desiccated coconut and bake for about 30 minutes.
The source presents these protein-rich egg recipes as a way to vary meals instead of eating plain boiled eggs every day.

iridium-71.name: Protein chicken pie
steps: Mash the sweet potato with a fork. Add the whole eggs, egg whites, flours, chia and whey and mix thoroughly. In another bowl, combine all the filling ingredients.
Cover the bottom of a baking tin with enough dough. Add the filling and cover with the remaining dough. Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for approximately 30 minutes.

iridium-72.name: Savoury pancake
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla or unflavoured whey protein
1/4 water (unit not specified in the source)
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth. The batter should be quite liquid; add a little more milk if too thick. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a non-stick frying pan.
Pour in a ladle of batter and spread over the whole pan. Cook over low heat until golden and turn carefully. Choose your favourite filling for this whey protein pancake.

iridium-73.name: Chicken coxinhas
ingredients: Rolled oats and/or golden flaxseed for coating
steps: Cook and peel the sweet potatoes, then mash with the olive oil. Add the whey and oat flour to bind, and refrigerate the mash for 20 minutes.
In another pan, cook the chicken with seasonings of your choice and shred it.
Remove the mash from the refrigerator and mix in 2 spoons of shredded chicken to make it firmer.
Shape small discs of sweet potato mash, fill with shredded chicken and close into coxinha shapes. Keep them small.
Dip the coxinhas in egg, then coat with rolled oats. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden and serve.

iridium-74.name: Cassava bread with whey
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter at room temperature
2 cups unflavoured or vanilla whey protein
steps: Dissolve the yeast in the sugar. Add the salt, eggs, butter and cassava, mix, then add the whey. Knead until soft, adding more whey if needed to obtain a smooth consistency. Grease a loaf tin and put in the dough.

Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for approximately 30 minutes. The source presents these recipes as ways to satisfy cravings for sweets and dough-based foods during a diet and to complement a training routine.

iridium-75.name: Sweet potato protein brigadeiro
ingredients: 10 g cocoa powder or 1 grated protein bar for decorating
steps: Cook the sweet potato, mash it and add the whey protein. Mix with your hands until uniform. Shape into balls and roll in cocoa powder or grated protein bar to decorate.

iridium-76.name: Whey and oat pancakes
steps: Blend all the ingredients. Pour into a non-stick frying pan and turn once the pancake is firm. Add fruit when it is nearly cooked or after cooking.

iridium-77.name: Banana and whey ice cream
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla whey protein, or flavour of your choice
steps: Slice and freeze the bananas. Once frozen, process with the almond milk and whey. Stop the processor a few times to stir. The ice cream is ready when creamy.
